```{r helpers}
clean_sample_id <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(basename(as.character(x))))
  x <- sub("_S[0-9]+$", "", x)      # TP03.117_S25 -> TP03.117
  x <- gsub("\\.", "-", x)
  x <- sub("_T$", "", x); x <- sub("-T$", "", x); x <- sub("T$", "", x)
  x <- sub("_N$", "", x); x <- sub("-N$", "", x); x <- sub("NL$", "", x)
  sub("^(TP[0-9]+)-0+([0-9]+)$", "\\1-\\2", x)
}

safe_name <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]+", "_", x)

# Save any ggplot / pheatmap object as both PDF and PNG
save_plot <- function(p, base, width, height, dir = DOWNSTREAM_DIR) {
  pdf(file.path(dir, paste0(base, ".pdf")), width = width, height = height)
  print(p); dev.off()
  png(file.path(dir, paste0(base, ".png")), width = width, height = height, units = "in", res = 300)
  print(p); dev.off()
}
```

```{r load-model}

```

## 2. Clean clinical metadata

```{r clinical-clean}
clean_text <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  x[x %in% c("", "NA", "Na", "na", "N/A", "n/a")] <- NA_character_
  x
}

parse_numeric_clinical <- function(x) {
  x <- clean_text(x)
  is_lt <- !is.na(x) & grepl("^<\\s*[0-9.]+$", x)
  out <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub("^<\\s*", "", x)))
  out[is_lt] <- out[is_lt] / 2          # "<N" is coded as N/2
  out
}

standardize_pos_neg <- function(x) {
  x <- toupper(trimws(as.character(x)))
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(x))
  out[grepl("^POS", x)] <- "Positive"
  out[grepl("^NEG", x)] <- "Negative"
  out
}

make_hr_status <- function(er, pr) {
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(er))
  out[er == "Positive" | pr == "Positive"] <- "HR+"
  out[er == "Negative" & pr == "Negative"] <- "HR-"
  out
}

make_hr_her2_subtype <- function(hr, her2) {
  out <- rep(NA_character_, length(hr))
  out[hr == "HR+" & her2 == "Negative"] <- "HR+/HER2-"
  out[hr == "HR+" & her2 == "Positive"] <- "HR+/HER2+"
  out[hr == "HR-" & her2 == "Negative"] <- "Triple-negative"
  out[hr == "HR-" & her2 == "Positive"] <- "HR-/HER2+"
  out
}

pick_col <- function(dt, patterns, label) {
  hits <- unique(unlist(lapply(patterns, function(p) grep(p, colnames(dt), value = TRUE))))
  if (length(hits) == 0) stop("Could not find column for: ", label)
  hits[1]
}

clinical_raw <- fread(CLINICAL_FILE)
setnames(clinical_raw, colnames(clinical_raw), make.names(trimws(colnames(clinical_raw)), unique = TRUE))

sample_col <- pick_col(clinical_raw, "^Sample.name$", "Sample name")
age_col    <- pick_col(clinical_raw, "^Age.at.Diagnosis$", "Age at Diagnosis")
cell_col   <- pick_col(clinical_raw, "MirrorFFPE_overall_tumor_cellularity", "overall tumor cellularity")
pleo_col   <- pick_col(clinical_raw, "MirrorFFPE_pleomorphic_invasive", "pleomorphic invasive cellularity")
til_col    <- pick_col(clinical_raw, "MirrorFFPE_TILs", "TILs")
grade_col  <- pick_col(clinical_raw, "Grade.Differentiation", "Grade")
her2_col   <- pick_col(clinical_raw, "Her.2.Neu", "HER2")
er_col     <- pick_col(clinical_raw, "Tumor.Marker.*ER", "ER")
pr_col     <- pick_col(clinical_raw, "Tumor.Marker.*PR", "PR")

clinical_clean <- clinical_raw[, .(
  Sample = clean_sample_id(get(sample_col)),
  Age_at_Diagnosis = parse_numeric_clinical(get(age_col)),
  Tumor_cellularity = parse_numeric_clinical(get(cell_col)),
  Pleomorphic_invasive_component_cellularity = parse_numeric_clinical(get(pleo_col)),
  TILs = parse_numeric_clinical(get(til_col)),
  Grade = clean_text(get(grade_col)),
  HER2_status = standardize_pos_neg(get(her2_col)),
  ER_status = standardize_pos_neg(get(er_col)),
  PR_status = standardize_pos_neg(get(pr_col))
)]
clinical_clean[, HR_status := make_hr_status(ER_status, PR_status)]
clinical_clean[, HR_HER2_subtype := make_hr_her2_subtype(HR_status, HER2_status)]
clinical_clean <- unique(clinical_clean, by = "Sample")
setorder(clinical_clean, Sample)

fwrite(clinical_clean, CLINICAL_CLEAN_FILE)
clinical_clean
```

## 3. Add sample metadata to the model

```{r add-metadata}
# Join on a cleaned key, but keep the model's own sample names for the setter
model_samples <- data.table(sample = samples_names(model)[[1]])
model_samples[, sample_key := clean_sample_id(sample)]

sample_view_metadata <- fread(SAMPLE_VIEW_FILE)
sample_view_metadata[, sample_key := clean_sample_id(sample)]
sample_view_metadata[, sample := NULL]
sample_view_metadata[, view_completeness := fifelse(
  n_views_present == 1, "1 view", paste(n_views_present, "views"))]

clinical_metadata <- copy(clinical_clean)
clinical_metadata[, sample_key := clean_sample_id(Sample)]
clinical_metadata[, Sample := NULL]
clinical_metadata <- unique(clinical_metadata, by = "sample_key")

sample_metadata <- merge(model_samples, sample_view_metadata, by = "sample_key", all.x = TRUE)
sample_metadata <- merge(sample_metadata, clinical_metadata, by = "sample_key", all.x = TRUE)
sample_metadata <- sample_metadata[match(model_samples$sample, sample)]

if (anyDuplicated(sample_metadata$sample) > 0) stop("Duplicated samples after merging metadata.")

no_clinical <- sample_metadata[is.na(Age_at_Diagnosis) & is.na(Grade) & is.na(HR_HER2_subtype), sample]
if (length(no_clinical) > 0) {
  message("Model samples without clinical metadata: ", paste(no_clinical, collapse = ", "))
}

sample_metadata[, sample_key := NULL]
samples_metadata(model) <- as.data.frame(sample_metadata)

fwrite(sample_metadata, file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_sample_metadata_with_clinical_annotations.tsv"), sep = "\t")
saveRDS(model, file.path(RDS_DIR, paste0("MOFA2_pILC_model_", MODEL_TAG, "_with_clinical_metadata.rds")))

metadata_summary <- data.table(
  Metric = c("Total model samples", "Samples with clinical metadata", "Samples with HR/HER2 subtype",
             paste("Samples with", 1:4, ifelse(1:4 == 1, "molecular view", "molecular views"))),
  Value = c(nrow(sample_metadata),
            sample_metadata[!is.na(Age_at_Diagnosis) | !is.na(Grade) | !is.na(HR_HER2_subtype), .N],
            sample_metadata[!is.na(HR_HER2_subtype), .N],
            sapply(1:4, function(k) sample_metadata[n_views_present == k, .N]))
)
metadata_summary
fwrite(metadata_summary, file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_metadata_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")

metadata_available <- colnames(samples_metadata(model))
```

## 4. Variance decomposition

Variance decomposition shows how much variance each factor explains in each view. It also decides which factors are "focus factors" for the rest of the script.

```{r variance-decomposition}
variance_explained <- get_variance_explained(model)

r2_total_dt <- as.data.table(as.data.frame(variance_explained$r2_total[[1]]), keep.rownames = "view")
setnames(r2_total_dt, names(r2_total_dt)[2], "R2_total")
r2_total_dt
fwrite(r2_total_dt, file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_total_variance_explained_by_view.tsv"), sep = "\t")

r2_per_factor_dt <- as.data.table(variance_explained$r2_per_factor[[1]], keep.rownames = "factor")
fwrite(r2_per_factor_dt, file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_variance_explained_per_factor_per_view.tsv"), sep = "\t")

r2_long <- melt(r2_per_factor_dt, id.vars = "factor", variable.name = "view", value.name = "R2")
r2_long[, `:=`(factor = as.character(factor), view = as.character(view), R2 = as.numeric(R2))]
r2_long <- r2_long[order(match(factor, factor_names), -R2)]
fwrite(r2_long, file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_variance_explained_per_factor_per_view_long.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# Dominant view and summary per factor
dominant_view <- r2_long[, .SD[which.max(R2)], by = factor]
setnames(dominant_view, c("view", "R2"), c("dominant_view", "dominant_view_R2"))
dominant_view <- dominant_view[order(match(factor, factor_names))]
dominant_view
fwrite(dominant_view, file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_dominant_view_per_factor.tsv"), sep = "\t")

factor_r2_summary <- r2_long[, .(mean_R2_across_views = mean(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 max_R2_across_views = max(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 sum_R2_across_views = sum(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 n_views_with_R2_gt_1pct = sum(R2 > 1, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 n_views_with_R2_gt_5pct = sum(R2 > 5, na.rm = TRUE)),
                             by = factor][order(-sum_R2_across_views)]
factor_r2_summary
fwrite(factor_r2_summary, file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_variance_summary.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# ---- Focus factors ----
if (!is.null(FOCUS_FACTORS_OVERRIDE)) {
  FOCUS_FACTORS <- FOCUS_FACTORS_OVERRIDE
} else {
  max_r2 <- r2_long[, .(max_R2 = max(R2, na.rm = TRUE)), by = factor]
  FOCUS_FACTORS <- sort(match(max_r2[max_R2 >= FOCUS_R2_CUTOFF, factor], factor_names))
  if (length(FOCUS_FACTORS) == 0) {            # fallback: top 2 factors
    FOCUS_FACTORS <- sort(match(max_r2[order(-max_R2)][1:min(2, .N), factor], factor_names))
  }
}
FOCUS_FACTOR_NAMES <- factor_names[FOCUS_FACTORS]
message("Focus factors: ", paste(FOCUS_FACTOR_NAMES, collapse = ", "))

# ---- Plots ----
p_var <- plot_variance_explained(model, x = "view", y = "factor")
save_plot(p_var, "MOFA2_variance_explained_factor_by_view", 9, 6)

p_var_total <- plot_variance_explained(model, x = "view", y = "factor", plot_total = TRUE)
p_total <- if (is.list(p_var_total)) p_var_total[[2]] else p_var_total
save_plot(p_total, "MOFA2_total_variance_explained_by_view", 8, 5)

r2_long[, factor := factor(factor, levels = rev(factor_names))]
p_heat <- ggplot(r2_long, aes(x = view, y = factor, fill = R2)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(R2, 1)), size = 3) +
  labs(title = "MOFA2 variance explained by factor and molecular view",
       x = "Molecular view", y = "MOFA2 factor", fill = "Variance explained (%)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1), plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
p_heat
save_plot(p_heat, "MOFA2_variance_explained_heatmap_custom", 9, 5)
r2_long[, factor := as.character(factor)]
```

```{r plot-factors, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
categorical_plot_vars <- intersect(c("view_completeness", "HR_HER2_subtype", "Grade"), metadata_available)
continuous_plot_vars  <- intersect(c("Age_at_Diagnosis", "Tumor_cellularity",
                                     "Pleomorphic_invasive_component_cellularity", "TILs"),
                                   metadata_available)

# Factor scores by categorical metadata (violin + dots)
for (mv in categorical_plot_vars) {
  p <- plot_factor(model, factors = seq_len(n_factors), color_by = mv,
                   dot_size = 3, dodge = TRUE, add_violin = TRUE, violin_alpha = 0.25)

# Factor scores by continuous clinical variables

# Pairwise factor scatter plots

  pair_specs <- list(HR_HER2_subtype = 6, Grade = 6, view_completeness = 4)
  for (mv in intersect(names(pair_specs), metadata_available)) {

    print(p)

}
```

## 6. Feature weights

```{r extract-weights}
weights_dt <- as.data.table(get_weights(model, views = "all", factors = "all", as.data.frame = TRUE))
weights_dt[, `:=`(view = as.character(view), factor = as.character(factor), feature = as.character(feature))]
weights_dt[, abs_weight := abs(value)]

# MOFA2 appends "_<view>" to feature names that occur in more than one view; remove it
weights_dt[, feature_clean := fifelse(endsWith(feature, paste0("_", view)),
                                      substr(feature, 1L, nchar(feature) - nchar(view) - 1L),
                                      feature)]

weights_dt <- weights_dt[order(view, match(factor, factor_names), -abs_weight)]
fwrite(weights_dt, file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_feature_weights_long.tsv"), sep = "\t")

top_weights_dt <- weights_dt[, .SD[seq_len(min(.N, TOP_N_WEIGHTS))], by = .(view, factor)]
fwrite(top_weights_dt, file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_top25_weighted_features_by_view_factor.tsv"), sep = "\t")

top_pos <- weights_dt[value > 0, .SD[order(-value)][seq_len(min(.N, TOP_N_WEIGHTS))], by = .(view, factor)]
top_neg <- weights_dt[value < 0, .SD[order(value)][seq_len(min(.N, TOP_N_WEIGHTS))], by = .(view, factor)]
top_pos[, direction := "Positive"]
top_neg[, direction := "Negative"]
top_directional <- rbindlist(list(top_pos, top_neg), use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
top_directional <- top_directional[order(view, match(factor, factor_names), direction, -abs_weight)]
fwrite(top_directional, file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_top25_positive_negative_weights_by_view_factor.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# Interpretation-ready table for the focus factors
interpretation_dt <- top_directional[factor %in% FOCUS_FACTOR_NAMES,
                                     .(view, factor, direction, feature = feature_clean,
                                       weight = value, abs_weight)]
fwrite(interpretation_dt, file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_interpretation_top_features_focus_factors.tsv"), sep = "\t")

weight_summary <- weights_dt[, .(n_features = .N,
                                 max_abs_weight = max(abs_weight, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 mean_abs_weight = mean(abs_weight, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 median_abs_weight = median(abs_weight, na.rm = TRUE),
                                 top_feature = feature_clean[which.max(abs_weight)],
                                 top_feature_weight = value[which.max(abs_weight)]),
                             by = .(view, factor)][order(view, match(factor, factor_names))]
fwrite(weight_summary, file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_weight_summary_by_view_factor.tsv"), sep = "\t")
```

```{r plot-weights, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
# MOFA2 built-in weight plots for the focus factors
for (vv in all_views) {
  for (ff in FOCUS_FACTORS) {
    for (kind in c("distribution", "top")) {
      p <- tryCatch(
        if (kind == "distribution") {
          plot_weights(model, view = vv, factor = ff, nfeatures = 10, scale = TRUE, abs = FALSE)
        } else {
          plot_top_weights(model, view = vv, factor = ff, nfeatures = 15)
        },
        error = function(e) {
          message("Skipping ", kind, " weight plot: view = ", vv, ", factor = ", ff, ". ", e$message)
          NULL
        })
      if (!is.null(p)) {
        print(p)
        save_plot(p, paste0("MOFA2_", kind, "_weights_", safe_name(vv), "_", factor_names[ff]), 8, 6)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r rna-weight-bars, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Top positive and negative RNA weights per focus factor.
# Genes in HIGHLIGHT_GENES (if any) are always shown and marked with *.
plot_rna_weight_bars <- function(ff_name, n_pos = 8, n_neg = 8, highlight = character(0)) {
  dt <- weights_dt[view == RNA_VIEW & factor == ff_name]
  if (nrow(dt) == 0) return(NULL)

  neg  <- dt[value < 0][order(value)][seq_len(min(.N, n_neg))]
  pos  <- dt[value > 0][order(-value)][seq_len(min(.N, n_pos))]
  hl   <- dt[feature_clean %in% highlight]
  plot_dt <- unique(rbindlist(list(neg, pos, hl), use.names = TRUE), by = "feature")

  plot_dt[, direction := fifelse(value < 0, "Negative", "Positive")]
  plot_dt[, feature_label := fifelse(feature_clean %in% highlight, paste0(feature_clean, " *"), feature_clean)]
  plot_dt[, feature_label := factor(feature_label, levels = feature_label[order(value)])]

  cap <- if (length(highlight) > 0) paste("* Highlighted genes:", paste(highlight, collapse = ", ")) else NULL

  ggplot(plot_dt, aes(x = feature_label, y = value, fill = direction)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.75) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 0.5) +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(Negative = "#3C78A8", Positive = "#B4513C")) +
    labs(title = paste0(ff_name, ": top RNA feature weights"),
         x = NULL, y = "MOFA2 RNA feature weight", fill = NULL, caption = cap) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 20),
          axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
          legend.position = "top",
          plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, face = "italic", size = 11))
}

rna_weight_plot_stats <- list()
for (ff_name in FOCUS_FACTOR_NAMES) {
  p <- plot_rna_weight_bars(ff_name, highlight = HIGHLIGHT_GENES)
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    print(p)
    save_plot(p, paste0(ff_name, "_RNA_top_weights_bar"), 12, 8)
    rna_weight_plot_stats[[ff_name]] <- p$data[, .(factor = ff_name, feature = feature_clean,
                                                   weight = value, direction)]
  }
}
fwrite(rbindlist(rna_weight_plot_stats), file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_RNA_top_weights_bar_plot_data.tsv"), sep = "\t")
```

## 7. Covariation patterns

```{r covariation-plots}
EXPECTED_COVARIATION_VIEWS <- c("RNA_VST_top5000var", "WES_CNV_numeric")
EXPECTED_MUTATION_VIEWS    <- c("WES_mutation_recurrent", "IMPACT_mutation_OncoKB")

# Stop (instead of silently skipping) if an expected view name is not in the model
missing_views <- setdiff(c(EXPECTED_COVARIATION_VIEWS, EXPECTED_MUTATION_VIEWS), all_views)
if (length(missing_views) > 0) {
  stop("View name(s) not found in the model: ", paste(missing_views, collapse = ", "),
       ". Views in the model: ", paste(all_views, collapse = ", "))
}

COVARIATION_VIEWS <- EXPECTED_COVARIATION_VIEWS
MUTATION_VIEWS    <- EXPECTED_MUTATION_VIEWS

scatter_vars <- intersect(c("HR_HER2_subtype", "Grade"), metadata_available)
if (length(scatter_vars) == 0) scatter_vars <- "view_completeness"

# Heatmaps (RNA, CNV and mutation views)
for (vv in c(COVARIATION_VIEWS, MUTATION_VIEWS)) {
  for (ff in FOCUS_FACTORS) {
    message("Heatmap: ", vv, " | ", factor_names[ff])
    p <- tryCatch(
      plot_data_heatmap(model, view = vv, factor = ff, features = 20,
                        cluster_rows = TRUE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
                        show_rownames = TRUE, show_colnames = TRUE),
      error = function(e) { message("Skipping heatmap: ", e$message); NULL })
    if (!is.null(p)) save_plot(p, paste0("MOFA2_data_heatmap_", safe_name(vv), "_", factor_names[ff]), 8, 8)
  }
}

# Scatter plots of top features vs factor values (RNA and CNV views)
for (vv in COVARIATION_VIEWS) {
  for (ff in FOCUS_FACTORS) {
    for (cv in scatter_vars) {
      message("Scatter: ", vv, " | ", factor_names[ff], " | ", cv)
      p <- tryCatch(
        plot_data_scatter(model, view = vv, factor = ff, features = 5, add_lm = TRUE, color_by = cv),
        error = function(e) { message("Skipping scatter: ", e$message); NULL })
      if (!is.null(p)) {
        save_plot(p, paste0("MOFA2_data_scatter_", safe_name(vv), "_", factor_names[ff],
                            "_colored_by_", safe_name(cv)), 8, 6)
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## 8. Association between factors and clinical features

```{r factor-clinical-tests}
factor_cols <- factor_names
clinical_continuous <- intersect(c("Age_at_Diagnosis", "Tumor_cellularity",
                                   "Pleomorphic_invasive_component_cellularity", "TILs"),
                                 colnames(factor_scores_wide_meta))
clinical_categorical <- intersect(c("Grade", "HER2_status", "ER_status", "PR_status",
                                    "HR_status", "HR_HER2_subtype"),
                                  colnames(factor_scores_wide_meta))
clinical_features <- c(clinical_continuous, clinical_categorical)

empty_result <- function(ff, cc, type, test = NA_character_, n = 0L, ng = NA_integer_) {
  data.table(factor = ff, clinical_feature = cc, variable_type = type, test_used = test,
             n_samples = n, n_groups = ng, estimate = NA_real_, estimate_direction = NA_character_,
             p_value = NA_real_)
}

test_factor_clinical <- function(dt, ff, cc, type) {
  tmp <- dt[, .(factor_value = as.numeric(get(ff)), clinical_value = get(cc))]
  tmp <- tmp[!is.na(factor_value) & !is.na(clinical_value)]
  if (nrow(tmp) < 4) return(empty_result(ff, cc, type, n = nrow(tmp)))

  if (type == "continuous") {
    tmp[, clinical_value := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(clinical_value))]
    tmp <- tmp[!is.na(clinical_value)]
    if (nrow(tmp) < 4 || uniqueN(tmp$clinical_value) < 3 || uniqueN(tmp$factor_value) < 3) {
      return(empty_result(ff, cc, type, "Spearman correlation", nrow(tmp)))
    }
    ct <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(tmp$factor_value, tmp$clinical_value, method = "spearman", exact = FALSE))
    res <- empty_result(ff, cc, type, "Spearman correlation", nrow(tmp))
    res[, `:=`(estimate = unname(ct$estimate), estimate_direction = "Spearman rho", p_value = ct$p.value)]
    return(res)
  }

  tmp[, clinical_value := factor(as.character(clinical_value))]
  ng <- nlevels(tmp$clinical_value)
  if (nrow(tmp) < 4 || ng < 2) return(empty_result(ff, cc, type, n = nrow(tmp), ng = ng))

  if (ng == 2) {
    wt <- suppressWarnings(wilcox.test(factor_value ~ clinical_value, data = tmp, exact = FALSE))
    lv <- levels(tmp$clinical_value)
    med <- tmp[, .(m = median(factor_value)), by = clinical_value]
    est <- med[clinical_value == lv[2], m] - med[clinical_value == lv[1], m]
    res <- empty_result(ff, cc, type, "Wilcoxon rank-sum", nrow(tmp), ng)
    res[, `:=`(estimate = est, estimate_direction = paste0("median(", lv[2], ") - median(", lv[1], ")"),
               p_value = wt$p.value)]
    return(res)
  }

  kt <- suppressWarnings(kruskal.test(factor_value ~ clinical_value, data = tmp))
  res <- empty_result(ff, cc, type, "Kruskal-Wallis", nrow(tmp), ng)
  res[, p_value := kt$p.value]
  res
}

assoc_list <- list()
for (ff in factor_cols) {
  for (cc in clinical_continuous)  assoc_list[[length(assoc_list) + 1]] <- test_factor_clinical(factor_scores_wide_meta, ff, cc, "continuous")
  for (cc in clinical_categorical) assoc_list[[length(assoc_list) + 1]] <- test_factor_clinical(factor_scores_wide_meta, ff, cc, "categorical")
}
assoc_dt <- rbindlist(assoc_list, fill = TRUE)

# BH correction across all factor x clinical-feature tests
assoc_dt[, FDR := p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")]
assoc_dt[, `:=`(neg_log10_p = -log10(p_value), neg_log10_FDR = -log10(FDR))]
assoc_dt[, p_label := fifelse(is.na(p_value), "NA", fifelse(p_value < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_value)))]
assoc_dt[, FDR_label := fifelse(is.na(FDR), "NA", fifelse(FDR < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", FDR)))]
assoc_dt <- assoc_dt[order(match(factor, factor_names), clinical_feature)]
assoc_dt
fwrite(assoc_dt, file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_clinical_association_tests.tsv"), sep = "\t")

fwrite(dcast(assoc_dt, factor ~ clinical_feature, value.var = "p_value")[order(match(factor, factor_names))],
       file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_clinical_pvalue_matrix.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(dcast(assoc_dt, factor ~ clinical_feature, value.var = "FDR")[order(match(factor, factor_names))],
       file.path(DOWNSTREAM_DIR, "MOFA2_factor_clinical_FDR_matrix.tsv"), sep = "\t")
```

```{r factor-clinical-heatmaps, fig.width=10, fig.height=6}
plot_dt <- copy(assoc_dt)
plot_dt[, clinical_feature := factor(clinical_feature, levels = clinical_features)]
plot_dt[, factor := factor(factor, levels = rev(factor_cols))]

make_assoc_heatmap <- function(dt, fill_col, label_col, fill_title, subtitle) {
  ggplot(dt, aes(x = clinical_feature, y = factor, fill = .data[[fill_col]])) +
    geom_tile(color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = .data[[label_col]]), size = 3) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red", na.value = "grey90") +
    labs(title = "Association between MOFA2 factors and clinical features", subtitle = subtitle,
         x = "Clinical feature", y = "MOFA2 factor", fill = fill_title) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5), plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
}

p_assoc_p <- make_assoc_heatmap(plot_dt, "neg_log10_p", "p_label", "-log10(p-value)",
                                "Cell labels show raw p-values; colour shows -log10(p-value)")
p_assoc_fdr <- make_assoc_heatmap(plot_dt, "neg_log10_FDR", "FDR_label", "-log10(FDR)",
                                  "Cell labels show BH-adjusted FDR; colour shows -log10(FDR)")
p_assoc_p
p_assoc_fdr
save_plot(p_assoc_p, "MOFA2_factor_clinical_pvalue_heatmap", 10, 6)
save_plot(p_assoc_fdr, "MOFA2_factor_clinical_FDR_heatmap", 10, 6)
```

## 9. Ranked pathway analysis (GSEA) of RNA weights

Each focus factor is analysed separately. All genes in the RNA view are ranked by their signed MOFA2 weight, and fgsea tests Hallmark, Reactome and GO BP gene sets.

```{r gsea-setup}
for (pkg in c("fgsea", "msigdbr")) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Missing package: ", pkg)
}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({ library(fgsea); library(msigdbr) })

rna_weights <- weights_dt[view == RNA_VIEW & factor %in% FOCUS_FACTOR_NAMES,
                          .(factor, feature = feature_clean, weight = as.numeric(value))]
rna_weights <- rna_weights[is.finite(weight)]
if (nrow(rna_weights) == 0) stop("No RNA weights found for the focus factors.")

# Gene symbols are used as they are. Only Ensembl IDs are mapped (version suffix removed
# for Ensembl IDs only, so symbols such as AC012345.1 stay intact).
rna_weights[, gene_symbol := feature]
is_ens <- grepl("^ENSG[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)?$", rna_weights$feature)
message("Ensembl-style RNA features: ", sum(is_ens), " of ", nrow(rna_weights))

if (any(is_ens)) {
  for (pkg in c("AnnotationDbi", "org.Hs.eg.db")) {
    if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) stop("Missing package: ", pkg)
  }
  ens_ids <- unique(sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", rna_weights$feature[is_ens]))
  ens_map <- as.data.table(AnnotationDbi::select(org.Hs.eg.db::org.Hs.eg.db, keys = ens_ids,
                                                 keytype = "ENSEMBL", columns = "SYMBOL"))
  ens_map <- ens_map[!is.na(SYMBOL) & SYMBOL != ""][, .SD[1], by = ENSEMBL]
  rna_weights[is_ens, ens_id := sub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", feature)]
  rna_weights[is_ens, gene_symbol := ens_map$SYMBOL[match(ens_id, ens_map$ENSEMBL)]]
  rna_weights[, ens_id := NULL]
}
rna_weights <- rna_weights[!is.na(gene_symbol) & gene_symbol != ""]

# One entry per gene and factor: keep the largest absolute weight
rna_weights_unique <- rna_weights[, .SD[which.max(abs(weight))], by = .(factor, gene_symbol)]
rna_weights_unique <- rna_weights_unique[order(match(factor, factor_names), -weight)]
fwrite(rna_weights_unique, file.path(GSEA_DIR, "Focus_factors_all_RNA_weights_mapped.tsv"), sep = "\t")

# MSigDB collections (works with recent and older msigdbr versions)
get_msigdb <- function(collection_name, subcollection_name = NULL) {
  args <- names(formals(msigdbr::msigdbr))
  if ("collection" %in% args) {
    a <- list(species = "Homo sapiens", collection = collection_name)
    if (!is.null(subcollection_name) && "subcollection" %in% args) a$subcollection <- subcollection_name
  } else {
    a <- list(species = "Homo sapiens", category = collection_name)
    if (!is.null(subcollection_name) && "subcategory" %in% args) a$subcategory <- subcollection_name
  }
  as.data.table(do.call(msigdbr::msigdbr, a))
}

make_pathway_list <- function(msig_dt) {
  msig_dt <- msig_dt[!is.na(gene_symbol) & gene_symbol != "" & !is.na(gs_name) & gs_name != ""]
  split(msig_dt$gene_symbol, msig_dt$gs_name)
}

pathway_collections <- list(
  Hallmark = make_pathway_list(get_msigdb("H")),
  Reactome = make_pathway_list(get_msigdb("C2", "CP:REACTOME")),
  GO_BP    = make_pathway_list(get_msigdb("C5", "GO:BP"))
)
```

```{r gsea-run}
run_gsea <- function(weight_dt, pathways, factor_name, collection_name) {
  ranks <- sort(setNames(weight_dt$weight, weight_dt$gene_symbol), decreasing = TRUE)
  if (length(ranks) < 100) stop("Too few genes for GSEA in ", factor_name)

  set.seed(SEED)
  res <- as.data.table(fgseaMultilevel(pathways = pathways, stats = ranks,
                                       minSize = MIN_PATHWAY_SIZE, maxSize = MAX_PATHWAY_SIZE))
  res[, leadingEdge := vapply(leadingEdge, function(x) paste(x, collapse = ";"), character(1))]
  res[, `:=`(factor = factor_name, collection = collection_name,
             direction = fifelse(NES > 0, "Positive factor weights", "Negative factor weights"))]
  res[]
}

gsea_list <- list()
for (ff_name in FOCUS_FACTOR_NAMES) {
  for (coll in names(pathway_collections)) {
    message("GSEA: ", ff_name, " | ", coll)
    gsea_list[[paste(ff_name, coll)]] <- run_gsea(rna_weights_unique[factor == ff_name],
                                                  pathway_collections[[coll]], ff_name, coll)
  }
}
gsea_results <- rbindlist(gsea_list, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
gsea_results <- gsea_results[order(match(factor, factor_names), collection, padj, -abs(NES))]
fwrite(gsea_results, file.path(GSEA_DIR, "Focus_factors_ranked_GSEA_all_results.tsv"), sep = "\t")

gsea_significant <- gsea_results[!is.na(padj) & padj < FDR_CUTOFF]
fwrite(gsea_significant, file.path(GSEA_DIR, "Focus_factors_ranked_GSEA_FDR_significant.tsv"), sep = "\t")
fwrite(gsea_significant[collection == "Hallmark"],
       file.path(GSEA_DIR, "Focus_factors_Hallmark_GSEA_FDR_significant.tsv"), sep = "\t")

gsea_significant[, .N, by = .(factor, collection)][order(match(factor, factor_names), collection)]
```

```{r gsea-plots, fig.width=11, fig.height=8}
collection_colors <- c(GO_BP = "#3C78A8", Reactome = "#7B5EA7", Hallmark = "#D97A2B")

plot_gsea_factor <- function(sig_dt, ff_name, top_n = TOP_PATHWAYS_PLOT) {
  d <- sig_dt[factor == ff_name]
  if (nrow(d) == 0) { message("No FDR-significant pathways for ", ff_name); return(NULL) }
  # Top pathways per direction, so negative-weight pathways are not hidden by strong positive ones
  d <- rbindlist(list(d[NES > 0][order(-NES)][seq_len(min(.N, top_n))],
                      d[NES < 0][order(NES)][seq_len(min(.N, top_n))]))
  d <- d[order(NES)]

  lab <- d$pathway
  lab <- sub("^GOBP_", "GO BP: ", lab)
  lab <- sub("^REACTOME_", "Reactome: ", lab)
  lab <- sub("^HALLMARK_", "Hallmark: ", lab)
  # Wrap long labels over several lines so the plot area keeps enough width
  lab <- vapply(strwrap(gsub("_", " ", lab), width = LABEL_WRAP_WIDTH, simplify = FALSE),
                paste, character(1), collapse = "\n")
  lab <- make.unique(lab)
  d[, pathway_label := factor(lab, levels = lab)]

  ggplot(d, aes(x = NES, y = pathway_label, fill = collection)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey35", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_col(width = 0.72) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = collection_colors, name = "Pathway collection") +
    labs(title = paste0(ff_name, ": significant pathways from RNA-weight GSEA"),
         subtitle = paste0("FDR < ", FDR_CUTOFF, "; top ", top_n, " per direction by NES shown (full list in table)"),
         x = "Normalized enrichment score (NES)", y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
          plot.title.position = "plot",        # align title/subtitle to the full plot, not the narrow panel
          axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, lineheight = 0.9),
          legend.position = "top",
          legend.justification = "left")
}

for (ff_name in FOCUS_FACTOR_NAMES) {
  p <- plot_gsea_factor(gsea_significant, ff_name)
  if (!is.null(p)) {
    print(p)
    n_lines <- sum(lengths(strsplit(as.character(p$data$pathway_label), "\n")))  # wrapped label lines
    h <- max(5, 0.2 * n_lines + 2.5)
    save_plot(p, paste0(ff_name, "_significant_GSEA"), 12, h, dir = GSEA_DIR)
  }
}
```
